```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)

# ── Artometrics color palette ──────────────────────────────────────
art_bg        <- "#FAFAF8"
art_cream     <- "#F2F0EB"
art_dark      <- "#1C1C1E"
art_mid       <- "#6B6B6B"
art_highlight <- "#C0392B"
art_secondary <- "#2C3E6B"
art_muted     <- "#D5D5D5"

# ── Artometrics ggplot2 theme ──────────────────────────────────────
theme_artometrics <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica") +
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = art_cream, color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = art_cream, color = NA),
      panel.grid.major   = element_line(color = art_muted, linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = art_mid, size = 9),
      axis.title         = element_text(color = art_dark, size = 10,
                                        face = "bold"),
      plot.title         = element_markdown(color = art_dark, size = 13,
                                            face = "bold",
                                            margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.subtitle      = element_markdown(color = art_mid, size = 10,
                                            margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.caption       = element_text(color = art_mid, size = 8,
                                        hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.margin        = margin(t = 16, r = 16, b = 16, l = 16),
      legend.background  = element_rect(fill = art_cream, color = NA),
      legend.text        = element_text(color = art_mid, size = 8),
      legend.title       = element_text(color = art_dark, size = 9,
                                        face = "bold"),
      strip.text         = element_text(color = art_dark, size = 9,
                                        face = "bold"),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = art_cream, color = NA)
    )
}
```

```{r load-data}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

meta_url <- paste0(
  "https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/api/1/metastore/",
  "schemas/dataset/items/9n3s-kdb3?show-reference-ids=false"
)

meta         <- fromJSON(content(GET(meta_url), "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
download_url <- meta$distribution$data$downloadURL
hrrp         <- read_csv(download_url, na = c("N/A", "", " "),
                         show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r clean-data}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

hrrp_clean <- hrrp |>
  rename(
    facility_name  = `Facility Name`,
    facility_id    = `Facility ID`,
    state          = State,
    measure_name   = `Measure Name`,
    discharges     = `Number of Discharges`,
    footnote       = Footnote,
    err            = `Excess Readmission Ratio`,
    predicted_rate = `Predicted Readmission Rate`,
    expected_rate  = `Expected Readmission Rate`,
    readmissions   = `Number of Readmissions`,
    start_date     = `Start Date`,
    end_date       = `End Date`
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(err)) |>
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      measure_name == "READM-30-AMI-HRRP"      ~ "AMI",
      measure_name == "READM-30-HF-HRRP"       ~ "Heart Failure",
      measure_name == "READM-30-PN-HRRP"       ~ "Pneumonia",
      measure_name == "READM-30-COPD-HRRP"     ~ "COPD",
      measure_name == "READM-30-HIP-KNEE-HRRP" ~ "Hip/Knee",
      measure_name == "READM-30-CABG-HRRP"     ~ "CABG",
      TRUE ~ measure_name
    ),
    penalty_tier = case_when(
      err <= 1.000 ~ "No Penalty",
      err <= 1.010 ~ "Low",
      err <= 1.025 ~ "Medium",
      err >  1.025 ~ "High"
    ),
    penalty_tier = factor(penalty_tier,
                          levels = c("No Penalty", "Low", "Medium", "High"))
  )
```

```{r fast-facts-compute}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: hide

# All values computed silently — referenced in Fast Facts HTML below.

pct_penalized <- mean(hrrp_clean$err > 1.0) * 100  # 48.1

avg_err <- mean(hrrp_clean$err)                     # 1.0018

err_by_condition <- hrrp_clean |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(avg_err = mean(err)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_err)) |>
  as.data.frame()
# 1 Hip/Knee  1.003985
# 2 CABG      1.001789
# 3 AMI       1.001755
# 4 Pneumonia 1.001486
# 5 HF        1.001439
# 6 COPD      1.001133

worst_state <- hrrp_clean |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(
    total     = n(),
    penalized = sum(err > 1.0),
    pct       = penalized / total * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct)) |>
  slice(1)
# NJ — 65.4%
```
